race.comment: KOBABILITY (7) progressed nicely third-up when leading pillar-to-post at Doomben. The rise to the mile is the main new test, but with added fitness and the cosy draw suspect she will run well. ROYAL DIPLOMAT (2) was dominant first-up at Dalby and while this is tougher he deserves respect. BETTER YET (8) was better in her last two before having a quick freshen. Her form over this track and trip warrants plenty of respect. FLOP SHOT (9) caught the eye last start when flashing home into fourth at Warwick. Is another that will appreciate the anticipated tempo and could cause a late scare. KNOWITALL FRANK (1) can bounce back into the placings after a last-start disappointment.
